parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a plastic cover that fits over the seat. It is lightweight and smooth, typically made of polypropylene or similar plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl when not in use, providing hygiene and aesthetic purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged at the back and can rotate upward or downward around the hinge axis.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic component located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism when pressed, releasing water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main ceramic structure of the toilet, including the bowl and tank housing.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user’s weight, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary once installed.
